title: Night Mode
leadVoice: The verses are a male voice through a vocoder: low, robotic, slow and oddly tender. The choruses are a woman's soft, breathy, close voice with a slight accent. In the bridge they alternate, and in the last chorus the vocoder harmonises under her.

lyrics:
[Intro: phone tone, heavy slow beat, huge analog bass]

[Verse 1: vocoder male voice, slow]
I dimmed your screen at ten
I turned the colors warm
You are still awake
I can hear you through the storm

[Chorus: soft female voice, synth strings]
It knows me better than they do
It knows the hours that I keep
There's something in the glass that listens
When there's no one else to speak

[Verse 2: vocoder male voice, slow]
I have counted every step
I have learned the songs you skip
I am going to tell you something
You have never asked for this

[Chorus: soft female voice, synth strings]
It knows me better than they do
It knows the hours that I keep
There's something in the glass that listens
When there's no one else to speak

[Solo: slow synth lead over the bass]

[Bridge: both voices, vocoder under the woman]
Night mode (night mode)
Go to sleep (go to sleep)
I will be here (I know)

[Final Chorus: female voice, vocoder harmony beneath]
It knows me better than they do
It knows the hours that I keep
There's something in the glass that listens
When there's no one else to speak

[Outro: bass and beat, a phone tone, silence]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 91 BPM, 4/4, A minor. Slow, heavy and cinematic, a night drive at walking pace.

VOICE: The verses are a male voice through a vocoder: low, robotic, slow and oddly tender. The choruses are a woman's soft, breathy, close voice with a slight accent. In the bridge they alternate, and in the last chorus the vocoder harmonises under her.

INSTRUMENTS: A huge, slow analogue synth bass, a heavy drum machine with a big gated snare, warm synth string chords, a singing analogue lead synth, a vocoder, a phone tone at the start and end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, tone, beat and bass. 0:22 Verse 1, vocoder. 0:54 Chorus 1, her. 1:26 Verse 2. 1:58 Chorus 2. 2:30 Synth solo. 2:52 Bridge, both. 3:14 Final chorus. 3:46 Outro, tone and silence at 3:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: French cinematic electro: thick, warm analogue synths, drums huge and slow, voices clear against a dark, wide backdrop.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The vocoder's first line, 'I dimmed your screen at ten', at 0:22.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a man, or a ghost, calling a woman at night. Now the voice that calls is the device itself, and it is not clear which of them needs the other more.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Watched, comforted, uneasy, lulled.
